runtime: native stdio; macOS arm64; Python 3.12.12 / Node 24.13.0; dependencies in uv.lock
limits: 未验证 Docker；独立 workspace/private HOME 是应用级约束，不是 OS sandbox
仅执行 server-profiles.json 已审查服务；安装 archive 不表示所有服务可运行
每次 run/adapt 使用新 output；失败保留
task223 uses explicit Netlify/frozen-source variant, not original EdgeOne; user login and linked dedicated site required
Third-party source may rate-limit; no silent old-paper fallback

checks: uv run ruff check src tests scripts
uv run ruff format --check src tests scripts
commands.adapt: uv run pe6203 adapt --strategy no_update --old-knowledge examples/catalogs/task139/early.json --new-metadata examples/catalogs/task139/early.json --output results/raw/NEW_ID/adaptation
commands.real_smoke: uv run --env-file .env pe6203 run --task-id 139 --version early --strategy no_update --seed 0 --config configs/local.smoke-no-reasoning.json --adaptation results/raw/NEW_ID/adaptation/adaptation.json --output results/raw/NEW_ID/run
commands.late_full_rebuild: adapt target=examples/catalogs/task139/late.json, strategy=full_rewrite; run version=late, strategy=full_rewrite; use new output dirs
commands.metadata: uv run pe6203 metadata --task-id 393 --version early --output results/raw/NEW_ID/task393-early.json
commands.persistence_probe: uv run pe6203 probe --version early --output results/raw/NEW_ID/probe-early
commands.batch: uv run --env-file .env pe6203 batch --plan configs/batch-task139.example.json --output results/raw/NEW_ID/batch
commands.netlify_setup: ./experiment netlify install; ./experiment netlify login; ./experiment netlify link

new_checkout_config: Copy configs/full-catalog-smoke.json to ignored configs/local.smoke-no-reasoning.json; set agent.model and judge.model from project.json
Set judge.extra_body={"reasoning":{"enabled":false}} for the selected OpenRouter model
Set AGENT_BASE_URL/AGENT_API_KEY/JUDGE_BASE_URL/JUDGE_API_KEY in local .env; uv --env-file loads explicitly; never commit keys
Batch example references configs/local.json; configure that file equivalently before batch, or use a new local plan
storage_estimate: Full archives ~3.40 GB download / ~12 GB extracted; verify SHA256 before extraction; scope=smoke installs only original two-server dependency closures
baseline: No Update + current LLM Full Rewrite + integrated deterministic Selective Patch; see CLI frozen plan for actual configuration.
